title: Imagine Live TV
style: Cinematic live-action video still, gritty, low light, handheld feel.
notes: The Final Spark: a choose-your-path video story. You wake in a sewer, found by a rat; each choice is a page with a video (TheFinalSpark/Decision tree.txt). One folder per branch in imaginelivetvwebsite.

branch-still.description: The opening still for a branch of the story.

branch-clip.description: Animate a branch still into its clip (give the still as start).

branch-text.description: Write a branch: its scene line and two choices, in the story's voice.
branch-text.prompt: Continue The Final Spark, a choose-your-path story that starts with waking in a sewer, found by a rat. Write the next page for: {prompt}. Keep it short and second person.

kinds._about: For the Hawkes Gen library (docs/library.md). imaginelivetvwebsite/hawkes.library.json brings the cast (story/characters) and the pages (assets/video) in. Page videos are made by Studio from hawkes.assets.json.

character.description: A character of The Final Spark: a frame from the filmed clips (seed) and the reference sheet made from it.

seed.description: A frame of the character from the filmed clips.

sheet.description: Reference sheet: front, three-quarter, side and back views and a face close-up, made from the seed.

params.prompt: Character reference sheet of this exact individual: {look}. Full-body front view, three-quarter view, side view and back view, plus a close-up of the face, side by side on a plain mid-grey background. Same proportions and clothes in every view. {style} {feedback}

page.description: A page of the story: its video (a shot with the narration).

clip.description: The page video in assets/video (made by Studio: hawkes.assets.json).
